item.title: The drone-defense complex: real moat or a hope about the budget?
item.description: Sam Calley on what Ukraine actually proved about drone warfare, why the airframe-vs-autonomy moat framing breaks, the rare-earth magnet chokepoint nobody prices, why counter-UAS may be the more durable line item, and where there's no clean trade. v3: two-pass spoken-word script, synthetic same-decode cast, pacing + C2 crispness master.

item.title: Who owns the muscles: the Japanese robot-actuator duopoly under siege
item.description: Maya Ito on why actuators are 40-60% of a humanoid and the precision reducer is the real moat — the Harmonic Drive / Nabtesco duopoly, China and Leaderdrive, the quasi-direct-drive design shift, the rare-earth magnet chokepoint, and whether the toll booth holds.
